data.body: **[P2] Unwrap failed oversized-result checkpoints before notifying plugins.** `handleLargePayload()` waits with `CompletableFuture.join()`, so a failed checkpoint reaches this catch as a `CompletionException`. Passing that wrapper to `fireOnInvocationEnd` makes Workflow Insight and OTel report the wrapper rather than the underlying durable failure, although the outer executor later unwraps it. Normalize the failure before the hook and rethrow, and add coverage for an oversized result whose checkpoint future fails.
